Kerala Congress Worker Sacked Over Objectionable Post Targeting CJI

The Kerala Congress has sacked a worker and deleted an objectionable social media post that targeted Chief Justice of India Surya Kant. The post, which included the phrase 'We’ll find your replacement', sparked a row. The Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) condemned calls for the CJI's resignation.
